data.title: 尤贝尔 · 海边捡到的有趣贝壳
data.description: 【黑沙海湾·午后】尤贝尔穿着深绿色分层泳装，赤脚蹲在潮线旁挑选形状古怪的贝壳；她举起一枚像魔法符号的贝壳端详，海浪突然漫过脚踝，侧马尾和裙摆一起被风吹向身后。
data.location: black-sand cove beneath a forest cliff
data.action: 潮线旁挑选古怪贝壳，海浪漫过脚踝后举起“有趣”的收藏
data.lighting: soft afternoon sun through sea mist
data.mood: 把假日当作观察实验的魔法使
data.promptProse: Ubel crouches at the tide line, sorting unusual shells into a little wooden tray, then lifts her most curious find toward the viewer as a wave reaches her ankles. Her deep-green layered swimsuit, short black beach skirt and shell jewelry remain in the horizontal medium view beneath windblown green hair. Afternoon sun through sea mist illuminates the selected shell and wet sand, with soft shade beneath the tray.
